text: {"lessons":["My account has risen overall, but a short run of gains is not evidence that prices will keep rising; past changes do not predict future ones.","Since losses bother me more than gains please me, I should keep risk appropriate to my needs without reacting impulsively to ordinary fluctuations.","I have traded rarely, and that has suited me so far; I should trade only when I have a clear reason, not simply because prices moved."]}
